expectedIssues: Loading spinner is shown on top of already loaded content
reportedIssues: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar hero image in 'Popular right now' displays a circular loading spinner in the center even though the image behind it has fully rendered. The spinner appears stuck/orphaned and obscures the food photo.

The favorite heart buttons on the two 'Popular right now' cards use different treatments: the first has a white circular background with a dark outline heart, while the second has a dark/transparent circle with a white heart, creating visual inconsistency.

The first card in 'Fastest near you' (Green Bowl Poké) has a very light, washed-out image background while the sibling cards use dark imagery, making the row look uneven; the white '15–25 min' badge also has weak contrast against that light background.
